products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.

La VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 es una de las mejores alternativas de la marca española. Esta como novedad incluye el nuevo carbono JACQUARD, que aumenta la durabilidad muchísimo.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Este modelo está recomendado para jugadores con un alto nivel de juego, sobre todo avanzados, puesto que estamos con un modelo de alta gama.

La VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 es una de las mejores palas Víbora de la temporada 2026.

- Formato redondo-híbrido. Es un formato oversize, completo y equilibrado y con un punto dulce muy ampliado.

products.englishDescription:
VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 - A racket that will give you total security in every stroke. With a round-hybrid format, it is a safe racket for right-wing players who want to take one more step towards the net. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 is one of the best alternatives from the Spanish brand. This new feature includes the new JACQUARD carbon, which greatly increases durability.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is recommended for players with a high level of play, especially advanced players, since we are dealing with a high-end model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 is one of the best Vibora padel rackets of the 2026 season.

Its characteristics are:

- Round-hybrid format. It is an oversized format, complete and balanced and with a greatly expanded sweet spot.

- JACQUARD carbon fiber, a new material, an improved and reinforced carbon for players who hit the ball hard.

- Professional Eva Rubber, Vibora's best rubber, developed in the high-end 2026 collection. This rubber is of medium density and with high response and ball output.

- New mold with an aerodynamic structure in the bridge, where air is allowed to pass and thus achieve better handling.

products.title: Softee Speed 3.0 Royal Power - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE SPEED 3.0 ROYAL POWER - Power and design united in this racket. Model of the high-end Softee 2024 rackets. An always reliable alternative for maximum power. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SOFTEE SPEED 3.0 ROYAL POWER belongs to the Speed collection, which continues to be one of the best from the Spanish brand year after year. This model has an innovative design combined with very good performance. Focused on a game especially focused on power.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for players focused especially on the attack zone. It is a teardrop format racket with a balance that is centered on the upper part of the racket.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The most important construction data of this new SOFTEE SPEED 3.0 ROYAL POWER are:

- With a teardrop format that looks great. This format is already known in other historical padel rackets such as the Enebe RSX for example.

- Made entirely of 3K carbon fiber on the planes and in the tubular, which will give us a lot of power.

- Rough finish on the 3D planes, for better effect on hits.

- Eva Soft S8 rubber.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, as we have mentioned, the SOFTEE SPEED 3.0 ROYAL POWER is a racket that is above all focused on power, although it is not a diamond shape, its teardrop format together with the high balance and its carbon composition, make it a very reactive racket in power hits.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro - Arturo Coello - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO - The new jewel in the crown of Head Padel. Worn by Arturo Coello, the world number 1. Racquet of incredible power, diamond shape and with the best technologies. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Discover your wildest side with the new HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO, which will be the racket used by the number 1 in the world, Arturo Coello, one of the young promises of this sport who in such a short time as a professional has managed to reach the top. This 2023 season and those to come, he will use this weapon, the Extreme Pro model, a diamond-shaped, aggressive racket, with high balance that generates extreme power in each hit.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this racket only for those players with an aggressive profile and who control attacking rackets. It is a racket that will surely take us to the next level in terms of power. If you play both forehand and backhand and are looking for the best power, this is yours.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to know in detail everything that one of the best Head rackets brings: the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO.

As we have already mentioned, it is the official racket of the professional player Arturo Coello, a new racket launched by Head to highlight the aerial power of its players. The diamond shape is the true protagonist, a high balance format but respecting a large sweet spot to also have good control. Its weight is 370 grams, which is ideal for delivering high power to blows.

Among its materials and technologies, we highlight Auxetic technology, which gives us greater power on impact and softness in blows when we want control.

In its framework we highlight Graphene, which is the material responsible for providing us with the greatest durability in that area. For its part, in the plane area we have a hybrid composition that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass, on a Power Foam rubber.

It is also rough. It incorporates Extreme Spin technology, to make our blows have more effect.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO is an extreme racket as its name indicates. Indicated to secure the points as close to the network as possible. For players who want to get the best vipers and finishes.

In defense it also performs great, as Head emphasizes this by incorporating flexible materials such as Foam rubber in the core.

products.description:
DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO - Versatility, power and control in a mold created by the first Conquerors of magician Juan Lartín Díaz. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot brings us reissues of its most legendary padel rackets, such as this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO, a racket in offensive format, with great punch and a sweet spot with which to keep up with the pace of the match.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO is made for advanced or professional level players. Offensive players with good finishing who get the most out of this model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO make it one of the highest quality Drop Shot paddles. Its format is teardrop, which gives us greater punch and aggressiveness in our blows. However, its balance is spectacular, feeling comfortable and easy to handle.

In its construction, Drop Shot uses 360 curved triaxial carbon on the face of the racket, a premium material in high-end padel rackets that achieves great touch and punch in our shots. Its frame incorporates double carbon tubular for greater durability.

For the core, Drop Shot uses quality high-rebound Eva Soft rubber, which provides optimal precision and ball feel to give everything in our matches and have exceptional control along with a great punch.

The rough touch appears on the faces, which improves the effects of our sliced ​​shots, thanks to the 3D rhomboid-shaped texture, patented by Drop Shot.

It incorporates an anti-vibrator in the heart of the racket, to reduce vibrations to a minimum and a silicone piece that is inserted into the handle of the racket, to improve vibrations even further if possible.

BLADE DESIGN

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO opts for a design in striking colors such as red, black and fluorescent yellow for the logo. A sensational choice by Drop Shot.

PLAY STYLE

The recommended playing style of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO are those styles with aggressiveness and punch in the blows, but with a good feeling of control.

PLAY STYLE

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2024 Jon Sanz - Palas De Padel
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for 2024 in the Premier Pádel professional padel league. A model that combines great precision, along with fantastic power thanks to its teardrop mold and technologies.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot is one of the leading brands in the padel racket sector. Models like the classic Conqueror have been with us for almost a decade. Today we bring you the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ, the new racket that the Premier Padel player Jon Sanz will use, and that seeks maximum power without losing the control that characterizes it.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has been created for advanced or professional level players looking for a versatile padel racket made of great materials.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ contains elements that make it stand out as a perfect padel racket for powerful players. It is a racket created in a teardrop format, with a good sweet spot and handling, which facilitates maximum power in the game without loss of control.

In its manufacturing, Drop Shot has used common elements in its padel rackets such as plain carbon and Hotmelt technology to make its frame more resistant and durable, a double tubular of carbon fabrics with maximum durability, which gives it greater rigidity and allows it to not lose power. Textrem Cubicarbon 18K twill technology appears on the interlocking carbon faces, giving the faces flexibility and greater durability for a more comfortable and pleasant touch.

Along with these materials, top-of-the-range technologies appear such as the 3D FACE, in a rhomboidal shape that provides greater spin to the ball when hitting, ideal for aggressive players and sliced ​​shots. The Anti Twist System technology also appears in this model, preventing vibrations, making this DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ one of the ideal padel rackets for players who want a powerful racket but with good balance.  In the core we find EVA PRO rubber with greater hardness and elasticity, which provides better control and touch of the ball.

It incorporates a protector on the frame of the racket to increase its durability, what the Madrid firm calls Ergo Pro Protector.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has opted for a striking color combination, which changes yellow, silver, black and green.

PLAY STYLE

The new DROP SHOT EXPLORER PRO 3.0 is one of the ideal Drop Shot rackets for advanced or professional players who want an attacking racket, but with good control.

products.title: Wilson Endure Pro V1 2026 - Momo González - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ - A new era is about to begin with this jewel from Wilson Padel. Momo González's shovel. Intended for players who want the best control in their game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

We present to you the most special Wilson Padel racket of the entire season, the WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ model, a racket with total maneuverability. It is Momo González's own model. If you are a fan of the round shape, this is yours. Its format will help us a lot to achieve a safe game from any area of ​​the court.

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is intended for players who want control over the ball, although it gives us a lot of power, thanks to its materials, it is a racket with 100% control, with a perfect round format and an ideal low balance.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ has materials that make it special. Deep work has been done on it to offer a completely new racket, with unique materials. On the planes, it incorporates unidirectional 3K carbon fiber. This new carbon treatment offers extra flexibility and much more resistance.

The interior incorporates dual-density foam called Control Foam, which improves the connection with the ball. This type of material offers incredible control over the ball.

One of the technologies it offers us is its double and reinforced Y-BEAM bridge, which helps us achieve better balance and reduce vibrations. It is a great padel racket to reduce arm discomfort.
